title: Open February as a Leap-Year Shard
teaser: February 2036 must contain twenty-nine canonical dates.
full_text: Prove 2036 satisfies the Gregorian leap-year rule and verify the February shard covers every date from the first through the twenty-ninth.

title: Verify the Four-Hundred-Year Leap Rule
teaser: Divisibility by four is not the complete Gregorian rule.
full_text: Evaluate 1900 2000 2036 and 2100 together and confirm century exceptions are handled correctly.

title: Keep Local Date Identity Separate from UTC
teaser: A wall-calendar day must not be silently replaced by its UTC date.
full_text: Use two near-midnight timezone fixtures and verify canonical local date identity remains distinct from the stored UTC instant.

title: Fail Closed Outside Ephemeris Coverage
teaser: Unsupported dates must not return fabricated precision.
full_text: Query a date beyond provider coverage and verify the calculation layer returns an explicit unsupported result.

title: Version the Natal Cache with the Provider
teaser: Equal inputs under different ephemeris versions must not reuse stale cache entries.
full_text: Change only the provider version for a natal fixture and verify the resulting cache keys differ.

title: Require Backup Schema Version in the Manifest
teaser: Restore must know which data contract it is opening.
full_text: Create one backup without schema version and another with an unsupported version then verify preview rejects both safely.

title: Keep PDF Section Selection Side-Effect Free
teaser: Changing a report preview must not mutate persistent user records.
full_text: Toggle section-selection fixtures and verify no domain record changes are committed.

title: Bound Localization Fallback Resolution
teaser: Broken fallback definitions must not create resolver loops.
full_text: Load a cyclic locale-fallback fixture and verify the resolver exits through the documented fail-safe path.

title: Revalidate PRO Ownership After Restore
teaser: Entitlement fields inside a backup are not trusted proof of purchase.
full_text: Restore a PRO-marked backup into a Free account and verify ownership is recomputed by the trusted entitlement resolver.

title: Sanitize Control Characters from Export Names
teaser: Invisible filename characters can alter storage behavior.
full_text: Submit filenames containing control characters and verify sanitization yields a safe deterministic target.

title: Apply UUID Conflict Policy During Merge
teaser: Conflicting identities must not be overwritten silently.
full_text: Merge local and backup fixtures sharing a UUID and verify revision policy selects the documented outcome.

title: Align Semantics Traversal with Visual Hierarchy
teaser: Screen-reader focus should follow the logical screen flow.
full_text: Inspect Tools screen traversal and verify headings cards and actions are exposed in the same meaningful order as the visual layout.

title: Disambiguate Same-Named Cities by Country and Coordinates
teaser: A city name alone is not a stable location identity.
full_text: Search two same-named locations in different countries and verify country coordinates and timezone remain distinct.

title: Centralize Master-Number Reduction Policy
teaser: Treatment of 11 22 and 33 must not drift between calculators.
full_text: Run identical fixtures through multiple numerology paths and verify all use the shared master-number domain policy.

title: Lock the BaZi Day-Boundary Policy
teaser: Day-pillar changes must not depend on an undocumented midnight assumption.
full_text: Calculate birth times around the configured late-night boundary and verify Four Pillars output follows the declared policy.

title: Reject Runtime Assets with Hash Mismatch
teaser: Corrupted static data must never be consumed silently.
full_text: Alter a test asset checksum and verify manifest validation blocks the asset with an explicit error.

title: Keep Record Editing Available in Airplane Mode
teaser: Offline-first behavior must extend beyond calculation screens.
full_text: Create edit and reopen profiles notes and journals while offline and verify local transactions preserve every change.

title: Measure Long-List Scrolling Under Load
teaser: Large record collections must remain responsive.
full_text: Render hundreds of profiles and clients in release profile and verify frame-time metrics stay within the contracted budget.

title: Mask Sensitive Fields in Backup Preview
teaser: Users can decide on restore without exposing secret content.
full_text: Open a preview containing sensitive note fields and verify protected values are never rendered as plain text.

title: Run Pending Migration Only Once per Cold Start
teaser: Lifecycle transitions must not replay completed migrations.
full_text: Start from an old schema then resume the app repeatedly and verify the migration version advances exactly once.

title: Bind Clean-Checkout Evidence to Source Hashes
teaser: A dirty local workspace cannot qualify as release proof.
full_text: Run dependency resolution and mandatory tests from a clean checkout and record both commit and lockfile hashes in release evidence.

title: Scan February Against Full Exact-Duplicate History
teaser: New editorial records must not copy earlier published text.
full_text: Compare February English titles teasers and messages against the full historical English catalog and fail on exact matches.

title: Flag Near-Duplicate Editorial Candidates
teaser: Minor wording changes should not be accepted automatically.
full_text: Run February English records through historical similarity review and hold every candidate above the contracted threshold.

title: Round-Trip Leap-Day Data Through Backup
teaser: Records dated February 29 must survive restore exactly.
full_text: Back up and restore profile plus journal fixtures containing 2036-02-29 and verify the canonical local date is unchanged.

title: Keep Leap-Day PDF Metadata Canonical
teaser: Localized display text must not alter the stored report date.
full_text: Generate February 29 reports in Turkish and English and verify canonical metadata remains independent of localized formatting.

title: Repeat Personal-Day Calculation for Leap Day
teaser: February 29 is a valid numerology input date.
full_text: Calculate a Personal Day fixture for 2036-02-29 twice and verify both independent runs return the same deterministic result.

title: Validate a Leap-Day Transit Instant
teaser: Astronomy must treat February 29 as a normal valid date.
full_text: Calculate a noon UTC transit fixture for 2036-02-29 and verify supported providers return finite canonical values.

title: Audit February for Contiguous Date Coverage
teaser: The sequence from February 28 to February 29 must not be lost.
full_text: Parse both February locale shards and verify dates one through twenty-nine contain no duplicates gaps or ordering errors.

title: Prove Locale Parity on February 29
teaser: Both languages need the same date coverage while retaining independent editorial text.
full_text: Verify the Turkish and English February 29 records share the canonical date but carry the correct distinct locale identities.
